invention.ref: Alfonso Bialetti launches the Moka Express stove-top coffee maker in Italy (1933)
invention.ref_zh: 阿方索·比亚莱蒂1933年在意大利推出摩卡壶

patent.ref: Related patent filings associated with Luigi De Ponti appear around 1950–51
patent.ref_zh: 与路易吉·德庞蒂相关的专利约在1950–51年出现

mass_production.ref: Bialetti began commercial production of the aluminum Moka Express
mass_production.ref_zh: 比亚莱蒂开始商业生产铝制摩卡壶

popularization.ref: Moka pots become everyday Italian household coffee makers after WWII
popularization.ref_zh: 二战后摩卡壶成为意大利家庭日常煮咖啡器具

locations.place_label_zh: 意大利皮埃蒙特十字军镇一带（比亚莱蒂）

sources.title: An idea with a mustache — Bialetti

notes: 公司史常写1933年发明，但早期专利署名情况较复杂，常见相关专利指向路易吉·德庞蒂而非阿方索本人；条目仍以1933年产品问世为主年份。
notes_en: Company histories date the invention to 1933, but early patent attribution is messy and often points to Luigi De Ponti rather than Alfonso Bialetti himself; this entry still uses the 1933 product launch as the primary year.
summary_zh: 摩卡壶是意大利炉灶煮咖啡器，由阿方索·比亚莱蒂于1933年推出；二战后成为意式家庭煮咖啡的代表器具。
summary_en: The moka pot is Italy’s stove-top coffee maker, launched by Alfonso Bialetti in 1933 and established as an everyday Italian household fixture after World War II.
summary_ja: モカポットはイタリアの直火式コーヒーメーカーで、1933年に Alfonso Bialetti が発売した。第二次世界大戦後、イタリアの家庭の定番になった。

image.alt_en: A Bialetti moka pot brewing coffee
